answer: Each applicant locks 70 at one inlet and keeps a live heartbeat. The nebula beacon draws 10% per epoch; a drawn identity answers in 10 minutes with a fresh key-bound proof. Proofs post to the ridge ledger for replay. A miss docks 14; three misses burn it. A rented heartbeat fails the key check. 1,000 fakes cost 12,000 per epoch, 120,000 over ten epochs, against the 40,000 pool. Honest agents lock 70 once, pay 12 per epoch, and keep a full share.
